shared_elements: a horizontal band of repeated ornament (interlace border / rosette frieze)
justification: Both surfaces depict small profile human figures engaged with carried objects and both include a band of repeated ornament (an interlace frame in A, a rosette frieze in B), plus an animal head appears in each, but these are generic correspondences. A is a vertically stacked, compartmented composition dominated by a rider on a multi-legged horse, a ship with a sail and warriors, all set inside a mushroom-shaped interlace frame; B is a single continuous horizontal procession of near-identical robed men bearing bowls and vessels, with no framing, no vessel-of-travel, and quite different, more naturalistic figure proportions and drapery rendering.
